description: In front of you on the green-covered surface there’s a small stack of colorful plates near the right side. The left hand reaches in from the lower left, touches the top yellow plate and lifts it off the stack, setting it down slightly to the left; then the left hand lifts the next green plate and places it down in front-left, and finally lifts the red plate to reveal a blue plate underneath, sliding the red plate away so the plates end up spread out rather than stacked.
